For the first time, I embarked on a very special journey with my mother and cousin. We walked approximately 110 kilometres barefoot from Sultanganj to Deoghar in Jharkhand as part of the sacred Bol Bam Yatra.
This is not an ordinary journey. Every year, thousands of devotees undertake this pilgrimage to collect holy water from the Ganga River at Sultanganj and carry it all the way to Baba Baidyanath Dham in Deoghar, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva.
